_comment: Tier-2: the KratosSwimmingDEMApplication wheel is stuck at 10.4.0 and pins kratosmultiphysics==10.4.0, so pip-installing it DOWNGRADES the core and breaks a newer stack. Pitfall (kratos.swimming_dem #2). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Verified against the index without installing it: the newest KratosSwimmingDEMApplication is 10.4.0 while every other application in this venv resolves at 10.4.3, so installing it would force the core down two patch releases. It was deliberately NOT installed — the fixture asserts its absence together with the presence of both prerequisites, so a future run that quietly installed it would go red. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. INDEX RENUMBERED 2 -> 1: guidance entries were moved out of kratos.swimming_dem's pitfalls list, which shifted the indices of the entries after them. The claim this fixture verifies is unchanged.
